description: Unit tests for x509_util functions related to Apple platform certificates, including creation and conversion of SecCertificateRef objects and X509Certificate objects.

methods.name: BytesForSecCert
methods.description: Converts a SecCertificateRef or void pointer to a string of its DER data.

methods.name: CreateSecCertificateFromBytes
methods.description: Creates a SecCertificateRef from raw byte data.

methods.name: CreateSecCertificateFromX509Certificate
methods.description: Creates a SecCertificateRef from an X509Certificate object.

methods.name: CreateX509CertificateFromSecCertificate
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from a SecCertificateRef and optional intermediates.
